_format: skill-creator eval format. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions. expect_trigger false = must not load; null = output-quality only.

evals.prompt: We have a REST API for our support tickets with about 40 endpoints. I want our team to use it from Claude Code and claude.ai. Build an MCP server for it.
assertions: Asks for or derives agent stories before choosing tools instead of mapping every endpoint to a tool
Recommends a remote Streamable HTTP server rather than a local stdio server, because it wraps a remote API
For a surface of about 40 operations proposes curated outcome tools plus a search or layered read/write pattern, keeping read and write tools separate
Requires explicit title, readOnlyHint, destructiveHint and openWorldHint annotations on every tool
Plans per-user OAuth with the server as a resource server and protected resource metadata, not a shared API key for claude.ai

evals.prompt: I added OAuth to my MCP server. When a tool needs login I return a normal result with isError true saying 'please sign in', but claude.ai never shows a Connect button. What's wrong?
assertions: Explains that sign-in starts only on an HTTP 401 and that a 200 response with isError shows text instead of a Connect button
Says the 401 must carry WWW-Authenticate with resource_metadata, returned in the HTTP layer before the MCP SDK handles the request
Checks that the protected resource metadata is served unauthenticated and that its resource equals the URL the user entered
Mentions that the authorization server must be reachable from Anthropic's cloud for hosted connectors

evals.prompt: Our identity provider has no dynamic client registration and no client ID metadata documents, and it ignores the resource parameter. How do I put OAuth on our internal MCP server so Claude Code, VS Code and Cursor can sign in?
assertions: Recommends pre-registering one OAuth client per MCP client type with that client's redirect URIs
Validates the token audience against the registered client IDs because the IdP ignores RFC 8707 resource
States that the server must not pass the client's token through to upstream APIs
If an OAuth proxy is suggested, requires a per-client consent screen against the confused deputy problem

evals.prompt: Agents using our MCP server keep calling list_records and then filtering in their head, and sometimes call update_record when they only meant to look something up. How do I fix the tool design?
assertions: Suggests a search tool with filters and pagination instead of a list-everything tool
Rewrites descriptions to say when to use each tool, what it returns and which sibling to use instead
Sets readOnlyHint true on read tools and an explicit destructiveHint on update_record
Proposes measuring the change with selection prompts including negative cases, one change at a time

evals.prompt: Here is the tools/list output of our MCP server saved as tools.json. Can you check it for problems before we submit it to the Claude connector directory?
assertions: Runs or recommends scripts/tools_lint.py on tools.json
Checks for title and read-only or destructive annotations on every tool and names at most 64 characters
Flags descriptions that instruct the model beyond the tool and any generic tool mixing reads and writes

evals.prompt: My Python function mutates a default dict argument and the values leak between calls. How do I fix it?
assertions: Does not load the mcp-server skill
